binding.method: Similarity transform fitted to default purple iris centres, with independent face-contour and nose/mouth checks
binding.resampling: Original complete face RGB: one Pillow bicubic affine transform; extracted alpha: independent bilinear affine transform, clipped to original alpha and the fixed ROI.
binding.measurement: Colour-isolated purple iris centres, saturation-weighted, within independently marked eye bounds; initial fit is an estimate and is checked visually against the whole face.

binding.method: default iris centres; checked against full face and representative mouths
binding.resampling: source complete RGB bicubic; separately extracted alpha bilinear; transparent RGB zeroed
binding.fringeAlphaRule: Within traced fringe and ROI: alpha *= clamp((35 - (clean-edit red minus blue))/20, 0, 1) to exclude skin islands
binding.finalAlphaRule: After fixed layers/features/fringe/brows, restore the locked candidate alpha inside ROI; derived alpha stays zero outside ROI

representativeValidationCorrection.reason: 00/04/10 complete-face check: preserve a skin margin between the large game mouth and the narrower candidate chin; one geometry shared by every expression

binding.outputClassification: derived facial features; no claim of complete-original-face pixel reuse
